name: estate-accounts
title: Estate accounts
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || deceased_name as name from estates order by ref

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select e.deceased_name as deceased, e.date_of_death, e.grant_date, e.currency, receipts_cents, payments_cents, distributed_cents, cash_held_cents from v_position p join estates e on e.id = p.estate_id where p.estate_id = $1

sections.title: Receipts
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, l.description, e.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join estates e on e.id = l.estate_id where l.estate_id = $1 and l.kind = 'receipt' order by l.occurred_on

sections.title: Payments
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, l.description, e.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join estates e on e.id = l.estate_id where l.estate_id = $1 and l.kind = 'payment' order by l.occurred_on

sections.title: Distributions
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, b.name as beneficiary, l.description, e.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join estates e on e.id = l.estate_id join beneficiaries b on b.id = l.beneficiary_id where l.estate_id = $1 and l.kind = 'distribution' order by l.occurred_on

sections.title: Debts still to pay
sections.note: Provided for before any further distribution.
sections.sql: select li.creditor, li.description, li.status, e.currency, li.amount_cents from liabilities li join estates e on e.id = li.estate_id where li.estate_id = $1 and li.status <> 'paid' and li.status <> 'written_off' order by creditor

name: beneficiary-statement
title: Beneficiary statement
for_each: select b.id, e.ref || ' ' || b.name as name from beneficiaries b join estates e on e.id = b.estate_id order by e.ref, b.name

sections.title: Your entitlement
sections.sql: select e.deceased_name as estate_of, b.name, round(b.residuary_share_bps / 100.0, 2) as residuary_share_pct, b.specific_gift from beneficiaries b join estates e on e.id = b.estate_id where b.id = $1

sections.title: Paid to you
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, l.description, e.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join estates e on e.id = l.estate_id where l.beneficiary_id = $1 order by l.occurred_on

sections.title: Estate position today
sections.sql: select p.currency, p.receipts_cents, p.payments_cents, p.distributed_cents, p.cash_held_cents, p.unpaid_liabilities_cents, w.window_status as distribution from beneficiaries b join v_position p on p.estate_id = b.estate_id join v_windows w on w.estate_id = b.estate_id where b.id = $1

name: inventory
title: Statement of assets and liabilities at date of death
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || deceased_name as name from estates order by ref

sections.title: Assets in the estate
sections.sql: select a.description, a.kind, a.institution, a.account_ref, a.status, e.currency, a.dod_value_cents from assets a join estates e on e.id = a.estate_id where a.estate_id = $1 and not a.passes_outside_estate order by a.kind, a.description

sections.title: Assets passing outside the estate
sections.note: Joint accounts and nominated benefits. Listed for completeness; not collected by the estate.
sections.sql: select a.description, a.kind, a.institution, e.currency, a.dod_value_cents from assets a join estates e on e.id = a.estate_id where a.estate_id = $1 and a.passes_outside_estate order by a.description

sections.title: Liabilities
sections.sql: select li.creditor, li.description, li.kind, li.status, e.currency, li.amount_cents from liabilities li join estates e on e.id = li.estate_id where li.estate_id = $1 order by li.creditor
